scene_description: Two young children are riding kick scooters on a paved path in a sunny park. The girl on the left has a colorful helmet and a rainbow skirt and rides a pink scooter. The boy on the right wears a blue helmet and a striped shirt and rides a blue scooter. Green trees and grass are visible in the background.

sample_answers: a pink scooter and a blue scooter
